description: Urban Transport Network Dataset of Oran, Algeria is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Seddik REGUIEG (University of Oran 2 Mohamed Ben Ahmed). First public release of the urban transport network dataset of Oran, Algeria, used for route planning and clustering experiments. Coverage: national (DZ); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
